narratives.body: CBS Sports reports that Seahawks quarterback Drew Lock was limited in practice on Wednesday. Heavy.com notes that the Seahawks made a decision regarding Drew Lock before their game against the Chiefs amidst ongoing quarterback controversy. Yardbarker suggests that Drew Lock's performance could influence the Seahawks' decision to retain or trade Sam Darnold. Yahoo Sports states that head coach Mike Macdonald is justified in sticking with Sam Darnold over Drew Lock, even after Drew Lock recorded seven interceptions.
narratives.headline: Drew Lock: Seahawks QB controversy and practice limitations
